requirements.description: A university student residence must be near schools and universities. Set to the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75) because the user's project depends on close access to university facilities.

User prefers energy class C or better, so the accepted classes are A1, A2, A3, A4, B and C. Floor area (at least 850 sqm) and capacity (60 people) are not energy-efficiency columns and are not included here.
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, which maps directly to surface_area.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: property type 'Uffici e assimilabili', surface_area >= 850, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, education score >= 75, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by distance from that point. The 60-person capacity from the user query is not an extracted requirement, so it is not filtered.
